subtitle: Cold for 24 hours. Hot for 12.
bullets: Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12
The lid goes in the dishwasher

problem.headline: Lukewarm by lunchtime?
problem.body: Most bottles give up after a few hours. The water you filled in the morning is room temperature by noon, and the coffee you poured at seven is cold before the first meeting is over.

features.title: Holds the temperature all day
features.body: Two walls of steel with a vacuum between them. Cold drinks stay cold for 24 hours and hot drinks stay hot for 12.

features.title: Two sizes
features.body: 500 ml for the bag you carry every day, 750 ml for long days out.

features.title: Easy to keep clean
features.body: The lid goes in the dishwasher. The bottle is rinsed by hand in a few seconds, and every part is BPA-free.

faq.a: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours on business days and arrive in 3 to 6 business days.
Yes. Unused bottles can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

faq.q: Can it go in the dishwasher?
faq.a: The lid can. The bottle itself is washed by hand.
